headline: Drone attack halts Iraq's Khor Mor gas field, cutting ~2,800 MW (two-thirds of Kurdistan power)'
dek: An explosive-laden drone struck the Khor Mor gas field in Chamchamal, Sulaymaniyah province, late Sunday ~23:00 Iraq time, hitting the gas storage unit and causing a massive fire; production halted, all crew ordered into shelters. KRG Electricity Ministry: generation capacity drops ~2,800 MW,…
sources: KRG Ministries of Natural Resources and Electricity (joint statement); Reuters (two security sources + field engineer); AFP (Kurdish security source)
fault_line: Who darkened Kurdistan — Iran/militias, or is the unclaimed strike being pinned on them while the PUK-KDP split boils? The fault line is attribution without a claim.
